nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model Coordinate Descent CV Routing Guard Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic metadata-routing and sample-weight support guard helpers from sklearn.linear_model._coordinate_descent.LinearModelCV.fit.

nodes.name: cd_cv_routing_enabled_branch
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit uses metadata routing.

inputs.name: routing_enabled
inputs.type_desc: whether sklearn metadata routing is enabled

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the routing-enabled branch is taken

nodes.name: cd_cv_sample_weight_support_guard_required
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit should reject sample weights under metadata routing.
nodes.type_signature: (sample_weight_is_not_none: bool, splitter_supports_sample_weight: bool, estimator_supports_sample_weight: bool) -> bool

inputs.name: splitter_supports_sample_weight
inputs.type_desc: whether the CV splitter consumes sample_weight

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the unsupported sample-weight guard should fire

nodes.name: cd_cv_sample_weight_support_message
nodes.description: Return the unsupported sample-weight ValueError text used by LinearModelCV.fit.

inputs.name: guard_required
inputs.type_desc: whether the unsupported sample-weight guard fires

nodes.name: cd_cv_forward_splitter_sample_weight
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit forwards sample_weight into splitter params.

inputs.name: splitter_supports_sample_weight
inputs.type_desc: whether the CV splitter consumes sample_weight

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether sample_weight is forwarded into splitter params

nodes.name: cd_cv_drop_estimator_sample_weight
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit drops sample_weight for the estimator refit path.

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether sample_weight is dropped before refit

nodes.name: cd_cv_default_routed_params_required
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit builds the default empty routed-params fallback.

inputs.name: routing_enabled
inputs.type_desc: whether sklearn metadata routing is enabled

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the non-routing fallback branch is taken
